item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
• The prompter now leads you — the line you are about to read rests at the marker, so finishing a line advances the scroll immediately instead of waiting for your next word.
  • Voice following starts faster — and no longer drops words spoken across recognition boundaries, so it never loses you after a pause.
  • Play fixed at slow speeds — long run times and slow per-line speeds used to freeze the scroll in place; it now glides smoothly at any pace.
  • A guided tour — offered on first launch and replayable any time from Help → Take the Tour.
  • A real Settings window — microphone, automatic updates, help and feedback, and your license, under ⌘,.
  • Close toggles for the markers panel and the prompter preview, and a fresh starter script.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
PowerCue 1.0 — the teleprompter that follows your voice.

  • Voice following with on-device speech recognition: pause and it waits, ad-lib and it re-anchors.
  • Karaoke highlight, jump markers, screen directions, and a fully styled dark-mode script editor.
  • Detachable prompter window with full mirror flips for beam-splitter rigs.
  • On-screen timer, run-time pacing with per-paragraph estimates, Word import and export.
